protocol.scope: Two new internally designed dynamic families: affine tracking and finite-capacity inventory with nonlinear stockouts/overflow; no external replication, consciousness test or universal polar claim.
protocol.hypothesis: Using learned within-pair effects in a context-dependent action planner reduces dynamic tracking loss compared with disabling those effects in the same estimator, subject to failure, cost and retention guardrails.
protocol.sample_size_rule: ceil((1.96 * pilot_sd_of_paired_seed_mean_difference / 0.0015)^2), bounded to [40,60]; no model tuning and no optional stopping. If unbounded n exceeds 60, precision limitation is declared.
protocol.primary_unit: seed, averaging all six family-by-regime cells equally
protocol.loss_definition: sum_i weights_i*(state_next_i-target_i)^2/sum_i weights_i; no reference-action oracle subtraction
protocol.practical_threshold_rationale: An a priori engineering threshold in squared state units, with channel scales around unit capacity; sqrt(0.002)=0.0447. It is not an empirical, biological or clinical threshold and will not be changed using pilot mean effects.
protocol.interval: paired nonparametric seed bootstrap percentile 95%; secondary intervals descriptive and unadjusted
protocol.return_rule: Mean loss on final eight steps of return context minus final eight steps of initial context; positive indicates poorer reacquisition, not a proof of catastrophic forgetting.
protocol.guardrail_operands: All compare paired with paired_lesion over equal-weight six cells per seed except inventory-only consequences (three regimes equally). Upper95CI failure-rate difference <=.05; upper95CI ratio of mean action costs <=1.15; upper95CI return_loss_change difference <=.005; observed summed act+learn walltime ratio <=2.5 (descriptive implementation guard, no FLOP claim); absolute paired hard violations=0. Inventory mean per-channel per-step stockout and overflow difference upper95CI each <=.002, an a priori engineering tolerance in flow units, approximately 17% of mean exogenous withdrawal. Passing tracking thresholds alone is not inventory consequence success.
protocol.inventory_metrics: Mean stockout/net-withdrawal deficit and overflow, and fraction of censored state transitions, are reported separately; tracking family has null values, never zero. Known state bounds are supplied to all controllers; clipped transition rows are excluded from all RLS learners.
protocol.decision_rule: Continue broader coupling study only if primary upper CI < -0.002, all guardrails pass, paired-minus-shuffled upper CI < 0, and paired-minus-dense upper CI <= 0.001 in combined diagonal+misaligned regimes. If only aligned paired regimes meet practical benefit, describe a conditional structural prior and pivot; otherwise suspend the exclusive polar-advantage claim. Any shortfall in pilot precision qualification is explicitly marked, never hidden.
protocol.negative_control_rule: zero and hold must each fail at least one final cell; if either passes every cell, evaluator is insufficient and no positive decision is allowed
protocol.tuning: No tuning scheduled; pilot serves executable validation, runtime estimate and predeclared sample size. Any design correction after pilot is disclosed before freeze. Final data are never used for design changes.
protocol.freeze_rule: Save protocol, source SHA256, pilot-derived sample size and UTC timestamp before first final environment generation. Final command requires exact source hashes and explicit reviewed freeze marker.
protocol.trace_rule: Every environment and controller transition is stored at float64 JSON precision in deterministic gzip, transported in deterministic tar chunks smaller than 6MB with a logical member index. The manifest enumerates exact seeds/cells/controllers, member/archive bytes and SHA256. Summaries, inference, decision, figures and TeX derive only from these files.

thread_policy: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 recommended and used for recorded runs
